messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: infra-error-rate-high (svc=inference-gateway, region=us-west1) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident created: PD-98432 -> paging oncall (oliver) :bell:
oliver: acked. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards and traces.
jordan: seeing a big uptick in 503s from the gateway to kvcache backend starting ~1718888800. 503s are connection resets on upstream.
anya: I can confirm increased RSTs on the keepalive socket pool between gateway and kvcache instances. Pattern looks like many short-lived connections flapping.
lee: any customer impact visible? Reports from support?
oliver: not yet customer tickets, but error rate > 7% for a few routes (chat/generate) and latency is spiking for some requests. Routing is failing fallback to smaller model variants.
jordan: grabbing raw logs now. snippet: ```
[2024-05-18T02:21:44Z] gateway -> kvcache tcp 11.22.33.44:1234 RST
[2024-05-18T02:21:44Z] http 503 /v1/generate request_id=abc123 span=45ms upstream_err=connection_reset
[2024-05-18T02:21:45Z] http 200 /v1/embeddings request_id=def456 span=120ms
```
anya: rolling keepalive diagnostics: many peers reporting `recv: connection reset by peer` after 30-45s idle. Looks like a kernel-level timeout on a set of kvcache nodes after an update.
oliver: interesting, we had a kvcache kernel tweak rolled in earlier today as part of canary. Did we bump net.ipv4.tcp_retries2 or something?
jordan: yes, canary id orbit-20240518-kvcache-rt bumped tcp_keepalive_time in the image. I have the deploy link: https://ci.redwood/5412.
lee: if this is a canary, we should scope rollback for that canary pool immediately and route traffic away. Customer impact is moderate: retry loops will amplify token costs.
oliver: switching routing policy to prefer stable pool in-us-west1-a and draining canary nodes now. Command: `infra route set-preference --service inference-gateway --prefer pool=stable-usw1-a`
anya: started drain of canary nodes (orbit-20240518-kvcache-rt) and toggled aggressive connection retries to 1 to reduce repeated failures.
jordan: after routing change, 503 rate down from 7% -> 1.8% over last 2 mins. still seeing occasional RSTs but much improved.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation suppressed (auto) because acked and mitigation in progress.
oliver: leaving note: oncall will continue to monitor for 30m. If error rate stays <2% for 20m, we'll close PD and mark resolved. I'll follow up with a blameless postmortem.
lee: I'll notify support to watch for customer tickets and prep a proactive PSA for affected tenants with high traffic.
anya: next steps: roll back the sysctl change from the canary image, and include kernel-level revert in the deploy pipeline. I'll open a rollback PR: https://git.redwood/kvcache/PR-467
jordan: saving traces and sample request ids for later root cause analysis: abc123, ghi789, xyz456.
oliver: thanks all. tagging followups: change-control review (anya), postmortem (jordan + oliver), customer comms (lee). I'll hand this to the next oncall in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident PD-98432 acknowledged by oliver and status set to "mitigating".
